assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: one square illustration for an English vocabulary memory card.
Exact target sense: satisfy / v. / 使满意.
Primary request: illustrate making another person satisfied with a completed task; the cause and the pleased reaction must both be visible in one wordless scene.
Scene and subject: a tailor has just finished fitting a plain blue jacket to a customer. The tailor kneels beside the now neatly fitted jacket, holding a short unmarked piece of sewing thread and a needle lowered safely; the customer views the excellent fit in a simple full-length mirror, smiles with clear contentment and gives the tailor a thumbs-up. The fitted jacket has smooth straight seams and a comfortable correct fit. Exactly two people. The customer's approval is directed toward the tailor and the completed fit, showing the work satisfies the customer.
Style/medium: hand-painted gouache with subtle colored-pencil texture on warm off-white paper, matching garden vocabulary illustrations.
Composition/framing: square, one coherent scene centered in the middle 70 percent, generous warm white margins, clear at small card size. Gentle daylight, muted blue, green and coral.
Constraints: no letters, numbers, signs, labels, logos, watermarks, speech bubbles, borders or card UI. No unrelated clothes racks, clutter, money, decorative icons, or captions.
